text: The small follow-up changes the light manifest from1.3 to 1.3.2 to match the registered version. The built-in theme test resolves every registered ID, asserts that the add-on is installed, then compares its version with data.version. A commit title naming the test does not mean the test changed. This is a source-level version constraint; no install or test ran.
title: Built-in theme registry versions must match installed manifest versions
